title: surface_sky_radiance_ratio: look-up tables of the surface-to-sky radiance ratio for above-water radiometry
description: Python package to load and plot the look-up tables of the surface-to-sky radiance ratio, Rss, used to correct the skylight reflected by the water surface in above-water radiometry. The values were computed with the vector radiative transfer code OSOAA for the OPAC aerosol models and a Cox-Munk rough surface (Harmel, 2023).
notes: Funding: French National Program for Remote Sensing (PNTS-2019-13).
